meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要快速美化 Markdown 文档的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly beautify Markdown document formatting

howto.what: Claude 会把纯文本或 markdown 文件整理成结构化排版：frontmatter、标题、摘要、标题层级、加粗、列表、代码块等，只调整格式和修明显错别字，不增删改写原文，结果存为 {filename}-formatted.md。
howto.when: 当你要求「格式化 markdown」「美化文章」「优化排版」等，或想改善文章布局时接管。若检测到文件已是 markdown，会先问你选优化格式、保留原格式，还是只做排版修正。

say.text: 把这篇 article.txt 格式化一下
say.note: 生成 analysis 和 formatted 两个文件

say.text: 美化这篇文章的排版，多加几个小标题
say.note: 按分析结果加标题、加粗、列表

say.text: 只做排版修正，不要改结构
say.note: 直接在原文件上跑，不生成副本

howto.what_en: Claude restructures plain text or markdown into readable markdown — frontmatter, title, summary, headings, bold, lists, code blocks — only adjusting format and fixing obvious typos, never adding or rewriting content. Output: {filename}-formatted.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "format markdown", "beautify article", or improve layout. If the file is already markdown, it asks whether to optimize, keep the original formatting, or only fix typography.

say_en.text: Only fix typography, keep the structure
say_en.note: Runs in place, no copy created
